verdict.rationale: Florida DOR's own pages disclose some prerequisites before filing. They recommend registering through the online Florida Business Tax Application, state that the eFile and Pay system requires a User ID and Password, and show that Direct File asks for a Reemployment Tax Number and FEIN/ITIN. They also reference a publication on logging into the new system, but there is no consolidated, exact list of account, credential and identity-proofing steps. The probe confirms registration and reemployment-tax transactions sit behind an authenticated login shell, so further walls are not stated up front. missing for 10: an explicit up-front checklist of every account/credential step, any documentation of identity-proofing or verification steps, the actual contents of the login publication, and hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed steps appear mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: The Department recommends that employers register to pay reemployment tax using the online Florida Business Tax Application
Log in to the eFile and Pay system below using your User ID and Password to view your reemployment tax rate.
Reemployment Tax Number and FEIN/ITIN ... Start a New Return
This publication provides information on how to log into the new system, retrieve a forgotten user ID and password, and available resources.
